summary.en: Communication satellites circle the Earth on ellipses solved from Kepler’s equation: they race through the near point and crawl at the far one, and each beams a downlink to the ground while it is close. The outer satellite sweeps out equal shaded areas in equal times, and every orbit closes so the loop repeats exactly.
